# dsh-tutorials

> Bilingual (中文 + English) tutorials for DeepSeek Harness: 28 posts covering getting started, architecture, plugin development, pre-publish checks with dsh-plugin-doctor, awesome-list review checklists, prerelease peer/ERESOLVE troubleshooting, plugin search, marketplace publishing, the undefined.prepare crash family, bug-family triage, and sandbox trust boundaries.

## Key facts

- Live site (GitHub Pages): https://zoahdev.github.io/dsh-tutorials/
- Every command tested on Windows (Node 24 / pnpm 11 / dsh 0.1.0-rc.6)
- Built from markdown with a static generator; docs/ is the deployable output

## Reading order

- zh-01/en-01: getting started
- zh-03/en-03: build your first plugin
- zh-06/en-06: health-check with dsh-plugin-doctor
- zh-08/en-08: prerelease peers and ERESOLVE
- zh-11/en-11: debugging the undefined.prepare crash family
- zh-25/en-25: community contribution workflow (triage/verify/GraphQL/family-ize)
- zh-26/en-26: passing the awesome-dsh-plugin submission gate (age/commits/regate/403)
- zh-27/en-27: bug-family triage (10 verified families / append increments / found a new family / family test conventions)
- zh-28/en-28: sandbox trust boundaries & fail-closed (#3245 run_code escape / allow-lists / verifiability / checklist)
